source_description: Inbox accounts@harbourline.co.uk, folder Suppliers / September 2026, exported 2026-09-30 08:05, twelve messages oldest first. Message bodies only: attachments named in the messages are not in the export.
scope_notes: Every message in the export was read. R01 to R11 are messages 1 to 11 in order: the supplier documents and payment-relevant requests, one record per document, so corrected, duplicate and void documents have their own records linked by corrects/corrected_by, duplicate_of/duplicated_by and voids/voided_by. Message 12 is marketing and is listed under not_supplier_documents.

Amounts are as printed in the message bodies. Each was checked: net + VAT = gross, and VAT is 20% of net where VAT is charged. Attachments were not available, so nothing was read from an attached file.

The extractor read only data/emails.md. The bank feed, PO list and supplier master were not read, so PAID, REFUNDED, POVAR and NOPO are not assessed here and no dec, appr or var is set. Pay, hold or exclude is the reconciler's call. The one exception is appr=NO on sup:northfield (rev 2), which records the principal's own answer, not an extractor decision.
Flags use the team flag vocabulary and reflect only what the emails themselves show.
Dates are ISO in this file. Times are as printed in the export, which states no time zone. Money fields are numbers in the document currency; null means the document does not state it.
